card.name: Homework-help forum replies and duplicates
card.fires_on: Words in Q&A forum answers that talk about how the question should be asked, such as 'a separate question', 'not helping me do my homework', or replies in programming help threads.

modes.label: Separate question wording
modes.description: Words in 'should be posted as a separate question' in a physics forum reply.
modes.example: this should be posted as<< a>> separate question.

modes.label: Homework disclaimer
modes.description: Words in a poster's note that they are not asking for homework to be done for them.
modes.example: You are not helping me<< do>> my homework.

modes.label: Programming forum replies
modes.description: Words in short replies in code help threads, such as instructions or flat answers.
modes.example: You need at<< least>> the one class for a program to run

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like homework and duplicate, which fit forum talk about repeat or homework questions.
card.plain: It lights up in online help forum replies that discuss homework or whether a question is a duplicate or should be separate.
